newsitem.title: CHINA: SOUTH CHINA IND MAKES OFFER FOR NORITY.
newsitem.headline: SOUTH CHINA IND MAKES OFFER FOR NORITY.

text.p: South China Industries Ltd said on Thursday its wholly-owned Micon Ltd would make a conditional cash offer for all outstanding shares of Nority International Group Ltd at HK$1.37 per share.

South China Industries said Micon had acquired 6.64 million Nority shares in the market during the past six months, bringing its stake to 94.2 million shares or 35.1 percent of Nority, triggering an obligation to make a general cash offer.
The offer price of HK$1.37 each, valuing Nority at HK$367.3 million, is the same as the highest price paid by Micon for Nority shares in the market within the past six months, it said.
South China Industries said Feng Shen Chuan, another substantial shareholder with a 20.8 percent stake in Nority, had not yet decided whether to accept the offer.
Nority's net asset value at the end of 1996 was HK$246.5 million, up from HK$190.7 million at the end of 1995, representing an rise in net asset value to HK$0.92 a share from HK$0.71.
Trading in shares of South China Industries and Nority was suspended on August 6 and due to resume on Thursday. South China Industries shares last traded at HK$1.09 and Nority at HK$1.36.
